description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bediwewa, Thamankaduwa D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120283 (24/120012)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in various villages of Polonnaruwa District under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership claims, cadastral maps, and title settlement procedures, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
